homeDescription: I'm a Netherlands based @web @developer, @project @manager and @web @designer creating awesome and effective websites and web applications for companies of all sizes around the globe. Let's @start @scrolling and learn more @about @me in mine @ReactJS based resume.
about_me_description: I'm Aniello, a Netherlands based web developer, project manager, and web designer creating awesome and effective websites and web applications for companies of all sizes around the globe. I'm an undergraduate in Computer Science.#I've 10 years of experience in software development and I usually spend my time making research and working in the field of IT to continue to grow. I've started with the basic programming language, like c, java, and Php.#My career is started in 2012 with my first website for an enterprise, since of that moment I've started freelancing during my college time, in 2017 I become internal of an enterprise and in 2018 I become the head developer of the company.#When I've understood the computer science was a true passion and not only a work I've left engineering and I've started my university study of computer science, at the same time I've continued to work to a lot of projects alone or as internal, but at the start of 2019 I've applied to the Red Square Team.#In most of the projects I was assigned to, I was left free to manage and manage my colleagues until I officially became a project manager within the team, but this did not move me away from programming the most important and critical are assigned to me, as well as the creation of styles as I can faithfully emulate or create an element that is required of me. I'm also involved as a lead developer of Azeroth Shard Launcher. I always look for perfect, effective, and practical solutions to any potential problem. I love the challenges that programming offers

work_elements.name: Bitvavo
work_elements.description: As a backend developer for Bitvavo, I mainly developed the administration panel for the support team, as well as the creation and maintenance of many features of other projects as well. My main tasks were the creation of a multilevel RBAC authorization system, the creation of endpoints. The main technologies used for the project are NestJs, Lambda, Typescript, Javascript, Npm, Graphql, Rest, Mysql, Typeorm, Aws, Docker, K8s, Github Actions

work_elements.name: Red Square Team
work_elements.description: The R.S.T. is a team of freelancers who work together to manage multiple projects of various entities at the same time, each has its main area of work, but at the same time everyone can do everything. Specifically, I deal with the development of the frontend with the creation of styles and all the graphic and functional elements, subsequently I connect everything with the server if it has already been created by my colleagues, but in the case of smaller projects I also take care of the server and the database.

work_elements.name: Proxt s.a.s.
work_elements.description: Proxt s.a.s. is a small local company that had set itself the goal of digitizing Italian stores to expand the online market and the possibility of meeting and booking professionals of all kinds through the Joomap app. My assumption made this possible, initially, the app was developed using ionic 1, finished the first version I rewrote the app in ionic 3 adding all the functionality necessary for publication.

work_elements.name: Website Developer
work_elements.description: At the age of 14, I started making websites using html, php, js and css, until then I had dedicated myself to cms. Gradually I got more and more interesting projects and bigger and bigger challenges that led me to love more and more the world of programming, until the day I received my first contract as a programmer as an intern in a company, and thanks to my previous career I was immediately qualified as a senior developer, my skills of self-management and team management have allowed me to almost always have a role as a project manager in team work
